title: Memory leak from unremoved event listeners
description: A long-running worker component subscribes to an event emitter each time a job starts but never unsubscribes when the job completes, causing listener count (and retained closures) to grow unbounded over the process lifetime and eventually degrading throughput.
acceptanceCriteria: Listener count on the shared emitter returns to its pre-job baseline after each job completes, including when a job throws.
No previously-passing behavior (job execution, event delivery during the job) regresses.
A test that runs 100 sequential jobs and asserts stable listener count passes.
Cleanup happens via a finally-equivalent path so a thrown error does not skip listener removal.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run the added listener-count regression test (100 sequential jobs) plus the existing worker test suite.
groundTruth: The subscribe call has no matching removeListener/off call; the fix stores a reference to the bound handler and removes it in a finally block when the job settles, success or failure.
